independent_computation.statement: Bloodsong's Expose Weakness makes the marked champion take a fixed percentage of increased damage from all sources for 4 s. The engine's damage-taken multiplier for a target under Expose Weakness is therefore m = 1 + amp.
steps: 1. Read the amp from the cached wiki text: {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources.

2. Resolve the {{rd|...}} template: parameter 1 = melee wielder, parameter 2 = ranged wielder (established from Tiamat 40%/20% AD and Hullbreaker's explicit ranged x0.7 / x0.5 second parameter in the same cache).

5. No other cached effect in this scenario's named items contributes a multiplier: Black Cleaver's Carve is armor reduction (a resistance-side term, not a damage-taken multiplier), and Fervor is movement speed.
independent_computation.result_condition: 1.08 is exact for a melee Bloodsong holder; the only other value the cached text can produce is 1.05, for a ranged holder.
independent_computation.absence_check: The prior state (leaf absent) means no Expose Weakness multiplier was recorded at all. That cannot be right under any reading of the cached text: Expose Weakness is an unconditional, quantified amp applied whenever the empowered Spellblade attack lands on a champion, so a support event that emits a multiplier must carry 1.08 (melee) or 1.05 (ranged), never nothing.
